bugs.title: status.json series.enabled not synced from production.json — root cause of 'shows as manual', missing next-part flow, and Zernio still showing on series tasks
bugs.notes: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: status.json series block stayed zeroed even when production.json carried full series data — the desync was the write path, not the read path. The bot DOES seed status.series from stage-a-request.json at job creation (index.js newStatus call), and every reader (task header in runtime.showTask, Zernio task:pub entry, next-part gating in taskKeyboard) reads status.series — so a single later rewrite that lost the block produced all three reported symptoms at once. FIX (write path, 3 layers): (1) pipeline/stage_b/common.plan_series_block(document) derives the status series block from a production.json doc — nested series object OR legacy flat series_* siblings, nested wins per field (same precedence as normalize_plan), self-contained so it works on a raw unvalidated doc, defensive coercions so a malformed plan never crashes a status write, non-series -> all-off block. (2) stage-b.yml: right after production.json passes boundary validation, write_status(series=plan_series_block(...)) non-fatally — covers every production.json-accepting path (all bot dispatches target stage-b.yml with production_ref path:jobs/<id>/production.json). (3) pipeline/stage_b/run.py syncs status.series from the raw plan as the run's FIRST status write (bot reflects the series even if the plan then fails validation) and re-syncs from the validated/normalized plan right after load_production_plan; stage-a.yml early stage_a_running write now carries the request's series block via a new --series-json flag on pipeline.status (is_final is only known once the plan arrives; Stage B fills it in). BACKFILL: scanned jobs/* — exactly ONE desynced job (manual-1787902548797); its status.json series restored from production.json via plan_series_block (state/assets/publishing untouched). 1 job already synced, 3 have no production.json. Low-cost one-time backfill done inline (no script needed — single job). SYMPTOM VERIFICATION (code-level): (1) header — showTask pushes 'Series: part N' only when status.series.enabled===true -> fixed; (2) Zernio — task:pub entry/publish menu has no independent series gate in zernio.js; the 'Publish' button showed because the task rendered as plain manual, and with the block synced the completed-series view + plan-gated affordances govern -> fixed at the shared root cause; (3) next-part — taskKeyboard's bug-48/51 logic requires status.series.enabled===true before it ever reads the plan's is_final via extractPlanSeries -> with the block synced the button now renders for non-final parts (verified plan.is_final=false for the backfilled job). LIVE VERIFICATION PENDING: workflow/bot changes take effect on the next Stage A/B run after deploy (deploy-freshness is bug-56's concern; a blocked deploy window is exactly what bug-58 now alerts on). NOTE: the pre-existing test_refuses_to_leave_terminal_state failure exists on origin/main (verified via git stash) and is unrelated to this change.

bugs.title: Deploy-failure notification — user should not be the detection mechanism for blocked deploys
bugs.notes: Deploy Bots workflow: failed bot tests silently skip Cloudflare Worker deploy with no alert. Add `if: failure()` step that calls Telegram Bot API directly with bot token from Actions secrets to notify bot owner: 'Deploy blocked: bot tests failed on commit <sha>, Workers were NOT updated. Check the Actions run: <url>'. Must not require Cloudflare-scoped secrets. | Started investigation: locate Deploy Bots workflow, its test step, and available Telegram secrets.
